description: This file is a PHP source script that defines functions related to a remote execution server for test cases, including executeTestCase and getTime, and initializes an XML-RPC server to handle remote procedure calls.

classes.name: IXR_Server
classes.description: A class (presumably) from the included XML-RPC library that handles the RPC server operations.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Simulates execution of a test case based on input arguments, returning a structured result indicating pass, fail, blocked, or scheduled status.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the current server time in HH:MM:SS format.
